requirements.title: MINVAL argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an integer, real, or character array; DIM shall be an in-range integer scalar; MASK shall be logical and conformable.

pending.MINVAL-ARRAY-integer-real-or-character-a: Positive source controls use integer, exact real, and character arrays; source-control mutations use logical ARRAY or scalar ARRAY and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MINVAL-DIM-integer-scalar-in-range: Positive source controls use DIM=1 and DIM=2 for rank-two ARRAY; source-control mutations use nonscalar, noninteger, zero, or too-large DIM values and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MINVAL-MASK-logical-conformable: Positive source controls use a logical MASK with ARRAY shape; source-control mutations use integer MASK or mismatched shape and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MINVAL result type, parameters, rank, and shape follow ARRAY and DIM
requirements.definition: MINVAL has the same type and type parameters as ARRAY; without DIM it is scalar, and with DIM it has rank n-1 and ARRAY shape with the DIM extent removed.

pending.MINVAL-result-same-type-and-parameters: Evaluate integer, exact real, and character MINVAL controls into sentinel variables and assert KIND or LEN plus exact selected values; mutate ARRAY kind or character length in source review so the characteristic checks change.
pending.MINVAL-dim-absent-scalar: For a 2x3 integer ARRAY, assign MINVAL without DIM to an integer scalar initialized to 777 and assert the unique minimum; companion DIM=1 call has rank one so the scalar path is distinguished.
pending.MINVAL-dim-present-rank-and-shape: For a 2x3 integer ARRAY, evaluate DIM=1 and DIM=2 controls and assert SHAPE results [3] and [2] with exact section minima; mutate DIM so shape and values change.

requirements.title: MINVAL without DIM returns nonempty minimum values
requirements.definition: For nonzero-size ARRAY without DIM, MINVAL returns the minimum value of all elements of ARRAY.

pending.MINVAL-integer-nonempty-minimum: Evaluate MINVAL([4,-3,6]) into an integer initialized to 777 and assert -3; mutate the negative operand to 3 so the selected value changes.
pending.MINVAL-real-nonempty-minimum: Evaluate MINVAL([-2.0,4.0,1.0]) using exactly representable real operands and assert -2.0 after initializing the result to 99.0; mutate the first operand to 2.0 so the selected value changes.
pending.MINVAL-character-nonempty-minimum-by-rel: Use default character array ["Z","A","M"] with equal-length elements, initialize the result to "#", and assert MINVAL(A)=="A" with LEN equality from guaranteed alphabetical default-character order; mutate MINVAL to MAXVAL so the selected value changes.

requirements.title: MINVAL zero-size ARRAY returns type-specific largest values
requirements.definition: For zero-size integer or real ARRAY, MINVAL returns the positive number of largest magnitude supported for that type and kind; for zero-size character ARRAY, it returns a string of LEN(ARRAY) copies of CHAR(n-1,KIND(ARRAY)).

pending.MINVAL-zero-size-integer-HUGE: Use a zero-size integer array, initialize result to -777, and assert MINVAL(array)==HUGE(0); pair with a nonempty companion [HUGE(0)-1] so the huge result is not vacuous.
pending.MINVAL-zero-size-real-HUGE: Use a zero-size real array, initialize result to -1.0, and assert MINVAL(array)==HUGE(0.0); pair with a nonempty companion [HUGE(0.0)/2] so the huge result is not vacuous.
pending.MINVAL-zero-size-character-last-collatin: Use a zero-size default CHARACTER(LEN=3) array A and a result initialized to "###"; assert LEN(MINVAL(A))==3 and that characters 1, 2, and 3 of the result are all equal, without asserting which CHAR(n-1) value the processor uses. Pair with a nonempty default-character companion ["Z","A","M"] expected "A" from guaranteed alphabetical order so the zero-size character result is not vacuous.

requirements.title: MINVAL MASK and DIM forms reduce selected elements and sections
requirements.definition: MINVAL with MASK equals MINVAL(PACK(ARRAY,MASK)); with DIM it reduces rank-one ARRAY directly or applies MINVAL to each selected rank-one section.

pending.MINVAL-mask-equals-packed-minimum: Use ARRAY=[-5,4,2] with MASK=[.FALSE.,.TRUE.,.TRUE.] and assert 2; mutate MASK to include the first element so the packed minimum changes.
pending.MINVAL-mask-all-false-uses-zero-size-res: Use integer ARRAY=[1,2,3] with all-false MASK and assert HUGE(0); pair with a one-true companion expected 2 so the huge result is not vacuous.
pending.MINVAL-DIM-rank-one-scalar-value: Evaluate MINVAL([5,-9,3], DIM=1) into an integer sentinel 777 and assert -9; companion no-DIM call has the same value but distinct source form for the rank-one DIM rule.
pending.MINVAL-DIM-higher-rank-section-values: For B=RESHAPE([1,2,3,4,5,6],[2,3]), whose rows are (1,3,5) and (2,4,6), assert MINVAL(B,DIM=1)==[1,3,5] from column minima and MINVAL(B,DIM=2)==[1,2] from row minima; mutate DIM to the other dimension so shape and values change.
